# Ashland Group kit proposal selector check

Prepared October 1, 2026. This report keeps the saved proposal inputs beside the preview result. Each row is one page with a language or local variant. The short labels below identify cases in this report. They are not production page IDs. An explicit exclusion removes only the variant named in that row.

| ASH-KIT-P1 | launch-en | Yes | No |

Sofia's additional test passed for this saved proposal. Megan reviewed and accepted the patch and this tested coverage on September 23. That result applies to ASH-KIT-P1.
